description: This PHP source file defines the LanguagePackageController class within the OrangeHRM administrative plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component for managing language packages, specifically initializing the 'language-package-list' component during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: LanguagePackageController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling language package related views in the admin plugin, extending the abstract Vue controller and initializing Vue components.
